slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A rotation about center O by angle θ maps each point P to P' with OP' = OP and angle POP' = θ. Counterclockwise is the positive direction. The center maps to itself, and each point moves along a circle centered at O.

About the origin: 90 degrees counterclockwise gives (x, y) maps to (−y, x); 180 degrees gives (−x, −y). The center can be any point, not just the origin.
